inspection: Full primary publisher article and Table1 image read. Main uses Table1 harmonic modes, control treats Table2a anharmonic fundamentals as harmonic surrogates, not a Dunham extrapolation.
scope: Single T-shaped well, measured ground-state rotation and computed harmonic three-mode model; analytic1500-4000K sensitivity, not a converged high-temperature state sum. Low barriers lie inside the thermally occupied region, and strong anharmonic coupling invalidates uncontrolled extrapolation. Linear minima on one connected potential are not extra independently counted species.

shared_conventions.mean_mass: Retained JANAF natural mean mass for translation; measured principal-isotope rotation is not a complete natural-isotope calculation.
shared_conventions.energy: JANAF physical D0 unchanged; no ZPE added.
shared_conventions.finite_domain: 1500-4000K is a sensitivity domain, not primary-author high-temperature validation.
